```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(lubridate)
library(openxlsx)

# =========================
# 讀資料
# =========================
data_hua <- read.csv("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/花蓮縣公車.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
data_ttt <- read.csv("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/臺東縣公車.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# =========================
# 做成函式 ⭐
# =========================
make_table <- function(data, area){

  # 年份
  date1 <- as.Date(data$資料代表日期.yyyy.MM.dd.)
  year1 <- year(date1)
  
  # 票種分類
  ticket_type <- as.character(data$票種次類型)
  
  ticket_type_new <- ifelse(grepl("HUA-399", ticket_type), "花蓮399",
                     ifelse(grepl("HUA-199", ticket_type), "花蓮199",
                     ifelse(grepl("TTT-299", ticket_type), "臺東299",
                            "非定期票")))
  
  years <- c(2023, 2024, 2025)
  
  # ⭐ 不同地區用不同票種
  if(area == "hua"){
    all_types <- c("花蓮399","花蓮199","非定期票")
  } else {
    all_types <- c("臺東299","非定期票")
  }
  
  # 數量表
  tab <- matrix(0, nrow=length(all_types), ncol=length(years))
  rownames(tab) <- all_types
  colnames(tab) <- c("112年","113年","114年")
  
  for (i in 1:length(years)) {
    y <- years[i]
    temp <- table(ticket_type_new[year1 == y])
    
    temp <- temp[all_types]
    temp[is.na(temp)] <- 0
    
    tab[, i] <- temp
  }
  
  # 百分比
  percent_tab <- prop.table(tab, 2) * 100
  percent_tab <- round(percent_tab, 2)
  
  # 成長率
  growth_112_113 <- (tab[,2] - tab[,1]) / tab[,1] * 100
  growth_113_114 <- (tab[,3] - tab[,2]) / tab[,2] * 100
  
  growth_112_113[tab[,1]==0] <- NA
  growth_113_114[tab[,2]==0] <- NA
  
  growth_112_113 <- round(growth_112_113,2)
  growth_113_114 <- round(growth_113_114,2)
  
  # 合併
  final_tab <- data.frame(
    "112年數量" = tab[,1],
    "112年%" = paste0(percent_tab[,1], "%"),
    "113年數量" = tab[,2],
    "113年%" = paste0(percent_tab[,2], "%"),
    "114年數量" = tab[,3],
    "114年%" = paste0(percent_tab[,3], "%"),
    "112→113成長%" = paste0(growth_112_113, "%"),
    "113→114成長%" = paste0(growth_113_114, "%")
  )
  
  # 總計
  total_count <- colSums(tab)
  total_percent <- colSums(percent_tab)
  
  total_growth_112_113 <- (total_count[2] - total_count[1]) / total_count[1] * 100
  total_growth_113_114 <- (total_count[3] - total_count[2]) / total_count[2] * 100
  
  total_row <- data.frame(
    "112年數量" = total_count[1],
    "112年%" = paste0(round(total_percent[1],2), "%"),
    "113年數量" = total_count[2],
    "113年%" = paste0(round(total_percent[2],2), "%"),
    "114年數量" = total_count[3],
    "114年%" = paste0(round(total_percent[3],2), "%"),
    "112→113成長%" = paste0(round(total_growth_112_113,2), "%"),
    "113→114成長%" = paste0(round(total_growth_113_114,2), "%")
  )
  
  final_tab <- rbind(final_tab, "總計" = total_row)
  
  return(final_tab)
}

# =========================
# 各自計算 ⭐
# =========================
hua_tab <- make_table(data_hua, "hua")
ttt_tab <- make_table(data_ttt, "ttt")

# 顯示
hua_tab
ttt_tab

# =========================
# 匯出 Excel（兩個 sheet）⭐
# =========================
write.xlsx(
  list(
    "花蓮" = hua_tab,
    "台東" = ttt_tab
  ),
  "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/花東定期票_分開.xlsx",
  rowNames = TRUE
)
```
